Sentence (English): We are still trying to get used to our new Bosch dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Liked my last Bosch better ] || ---------------- || We are still trying to get used to our new Bosch dishwasher. They've really tried to turn this into a connected/app required appliance. Our old Bosch would remain on when the cycle was done and beep whenever the door would open and close afterwards to let us know it was finished. Now the dishwasher automatically turns off, so we never know if the cycle has run or if it's still dirty. We are supposed to rely on a message to our app which only one of us gets. With the old unit if you opened the door during a cycle, you could just re-close it and it would automatically continue with the wash. Now you have to press the start button again, which we forget to do. The delay wash option is also more difficult now. Would love to bring back the old way of doing things.

I'm very satisfied with how it washes and dries, although it seems to use too much rinse aid. The drawer material seems very sturdy, but perhaps too thick. The cutlery drawer isn't very convenient for knives or long cutlery. The middle drawer is completely fixed, and the dividers can't be lowered, except for those for glasses. Sentence (English): I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them.
Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. I was worried because the exterior looked like it would be shallow, but when I actually used it, it's high enough to hold large dishes, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it's not flashy and is subtly pretty! Performance! I've been using it on the regular course and just pressing the power and start buttons. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. I turn the dishwasher on in the morning, go to work, and when I come home from work, the door opens automatically and the dishes are fluffy and dry. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher. It makes a little “whoosh” when the water drains, but it’s not really noise. It’s more like a notification that it’s almost finished.^^ Installation! They connected it to the water purifier without any drilling. I think a dishwasher is one of those appliances that you can’t live without once you use it. As an office worker, I’m so grateful that I have time to rest thanks to the dishwasher lady. Oh! I think I saved on gas bills using the dishwasher. When I wash dishes myself, I always leave the hot water on, but that seems like a waste.^^ I’m very satisfied with it in many ways! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient.
Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. I was worried because the exterior looked like it would be shallow, but when I actually used it, it's high enough to hold large dishes, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it's not flashy and is subtly pretty! Performance! I've been using it on the regular course and just pressing the power and start buttons. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. I turn the dishwasher on in the morning, go to work, and when I come home from work, the door opens automatically and the dishes are fluffy and dry. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher. It makes a little “whoosh” when the water drains, but it’s not really noise. It’s more like a notification that it’s almost finished.^^ Installation! They connected it to the water purifier without any drilling. I think a dishwasher is one of those appliances that you can’t live without once you use it. As an office worker, I’m so grateful that I have time to rest thanks to the dishwasher lady. Oh! I think I saved on gas bills using the dishwasher. When I wash dishes myself, I always leave the hot water on, but that seems like a waste.^^ I’m very satisfied with it in many ways! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): This was one of the products I had been considering among many things!
Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. I was worried because the exterior looked like it would be shallow, but when I actually used it, it's high enough to hold large dishes, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it's not flashy and is subtly pretty! Performance! I've been using it on the regular course and just pressing the power and start buttons. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. I turn the dishwasher on in the morning, go to work, and when I come home from work, the door opens automatically and the dishes are fluffy and dry. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher. It makes a little “whoosh” when the water drains, but it’s not really noise. It’s more like a notification that it’s almost finished.^^ Installation! They connected it to the water purifier without any drilling. I think a dishwasher is one of those appliances that you can’t live without once you use it. As an office worker, I’m so grateful that I have time to rest thanks to the dishwasher lady. Oh! I think I saved on gas bills using the dishwasher. When I wash dishes myself, I always leave the hot water on, but that seems like a waste.^^ I’m very satisfied with it in many ways! The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. I was worried because the exterior looked like it would be shallow, but when I actually used it, it's high enough to hold large dishes, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it's not flashy and is subtly pretty! Performance! I've been using it on the regular course and just pressing the power and start buttons. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. I turn the dishwasher on in the morning, go to work, and when I come home from work, the door opens automatically and the dishes are fluffy and dry. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher. It makes a little “whoosh” when the water drains, but it’s not really noise. It’s more like a notification that it’s almost finished.^^ Installation! They connected it to the water purifier without any drilling. I think a dishwasher is one of those appliances that you can’t live without once you use it. As an office worker, I’m so grateful that I have time to rest thanks to the dishwasher lady. Oh! I think I saved on gas bills using the dishwasher. When I wash dishes myself, I always leave the hot water on, but that seems like a waste.^^ I’m very satisfied with it in many ways! Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! Sentence (English): It's really refreshing.
Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. I was worried because the exterior looked like it would be shallow, but when I actually used it, it's high enough to hold large dishes, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it's not flashy and is subtly pretty! Performance! I've been using it on the regular course and just pressing the power and start buttons. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. I turn the dishwasher on in the morning, go to work, and when I come home from work, the door opens automatically and the dishes are fluffy and dry. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher. It makes a little “whoosh” when the water drains, but it’s not really noise. It’s more like a notification that it’s almost finished.^^ Installation! They connected it to the water purifier without any drilling. I think a dishwasher is one of those appliances that you can’t live without once you use it. As an office worker, I’m so grateful that I have time to rest thanks to the dishwasher lady. Oh! I think I saved on gas bills using the dishwasher. When I wash dishes myself, I always leave the hot water on, but that seems like a waste.^^ I’m very satisfied with it in many ways! Sentence (English): The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. I was worried because the exterior looked like it would be shallow, but when I actually used it, it's high enough to hold large dishes, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it's not flashy and is subtly pretty! Performance! I've been using it on the regular course and just pressing the power and start buttons. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. I turn the dishwasher on in the morning, go to work, and when I come home from work, the door opens automatically and the dishes are fluffy and dry. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher. It makes a little “whoosh” when the water drains, but it’s not really noise. It’s more like a notification that it’s almost finished.^^ Installation! They connected it to the water purifier without any drilling. I think a dishwasher is one of those appliances that you can’t live without once you use it. As an office worker, I’m so grateful that I have time to rest thanks to the dishwasher lady. Oh! I think I saved on gas bills using the dishwasher. When I wash dishes myself, I always leave the hot water on, but that seems like a waste.^^ I’m very satisfied with it in many ways! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ Good cleaning power ] || ---------------- || I think that dishwashers are one of those appliances that you worry about a lot before buying, but once you actually use them, you'll fall in love with them. We had a 3-person dishwasher before. We're a family of 3, and I wanted to quickly wash the breakfast dishes before going to work in the morning, so we used a 3-person dishwasher, but it was really inconvenient. ^^ Then this time, I ended up using Media's 6-person dishwasher. This was one of the products I had been considering among many things! It's a whole new world when I actually used it. ^^ First of all, the size/appearance is bigger than I thought. I was worried because the exterior looked like it would be shallow, but when I actually used it, it's high enough to hold large dishes, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it's not flashy and is subtly pretty! Performance! I've been using it on the regular course and just pressing the power and start buttons. The buttons are touch-sensitive, so you only need to press them lightly. The lighting color changes depending on the water temperature, which is also unique. It washes with a triple-blade double-tier basket. When I use the basket for large items like large pots, I can remove the upper basket and use it so that more can fit. I just remove it and use it. I stack them one by one and now I feel like I've become a Tetris king. ^^ Usually, dishwashers have upper and lower blades, but this one has triple blades so it seems to clean more thoroughly. The auto-open door after washing is really, really good! This is important! If the auto-open door doesn't work, it dries damp inside after washing, and it smells and it's really annoying. I turn the dishwasher on in the morning, go to work, and when I come home from work, the door opens automatically and the dishes are fluffy and dry. It's really refreshing. ^^ The auto-open door function makes a huge difference! Noise! The 3-person dishwasher was so noisy, but it seems like the world has become quiet since I started using the Media 6-person dishwasher. It makes a little “whoosh” when the water drains, but it’s not really noise. It’s more like a notification that it’s almost finished.^^ Installation! They connected it to the water purifier without any drilling. I think a dishwasher is one of those appliances that you can’t live without once you use it. As an office worker, I’m so grateful that I have time to rest thanks to the dishwasher lady. Oh! I think I saved on gas bills using the dishwasher. When I wash dishes myself, I always leave the hot water on, but that seems like a waste.^^ I’m very satisfied with it in many ways! Sentence (English): I think dishwashers are appliances that people agonize over before buying, but once they actually use them, they fall in love with them.
Comments (English): [ It has good cleaning power. ] || ---------------- || I think dishwashers are appliances that people agonize over before buying, but once they actually use them, they fall in love with them. I used to have a 3-place setting dishwasher. As a family of three, I used the 3-place setting because I wanted to quickly wash at least the breakfast dishes before heading to work in the morning. However, it was quite inconvenient. This time, I started using Midea's 6-place setting dishwasher. This product was one of the items I was considering among various options! Now that I've actually used it, it's truly a whole new world. First, the size and appearance. It's bigger than I expected. I was worried because the exterior looked like it might be shallow, but after using it, I found that the height is quite tall, so large dishes fit in easily, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it isn't flashy and looks subtly pretty! Performance! I have it set to the standard cycle and am using it by just pressing the power and start buttons. Since the buttons are touch-sensitive, I only need to press them lightly. It was also unique to see the lighting color change depending on the water temperature. It washes using a triple blade system in a 2-tier basket. When using the basket for bulky items like large pots, I found that removing the top basket allowed more items to fit. I use it without the top one. As I stacked them neatly, I felt like a Tetris master now; I'm really good at it! Usually, dishwashers have blades on the top and bottom, but since this one has a triple blade system, it feels like it cleans more thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing is seriously, seriously great. This is important! If the automatic door doesn't work, the dishes dry inside while damp after washing, and I feel like they might start to smell, which really bothers me. I turn on the dishwasher in the morning before leaving for work, and when I come back, the door opens automatically to find the dishes fluffy and dry—it feels so refreshing! The difference between having the automatic door opening feature and not having it is huge! As for the noise! Maybe my 3-place dishwasher was just so noisy, but since using the Midea 6-place dishwasher, it feels like the world has become quiet. It does make a bit of a buzzing sound when the water drains in the middle of the cycle, though. This isn't even noise; it feels more like a notification that it's almost finished. Installation complete! They installed it right through the water purifier connection point without any separate drilling. Once you use a dishwasher, I think it's one of those home appliances you simply can't live without. As a working professional, I am so grateful to have some time to rest thanks to the "Dishwasher Lady." Oh! I think I've saved on gas since using the dishwasher. When I do the dishes by hand, I leave the hot water running the whole time, so I guess that was quite a waste. I am very satisfied with it in many ways! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It has good cleaning power. ] || ---------------- || I think dishwashers are appliances that people agonize over before buying, but once they actually use them, they fall in love with them. I used to have a 3-place setting dishwasher. As a family of three, I used the 3-place setting because I wanted to quickly wash at least the breakfast dishes before heading to work in the morning. However, it was quite inconvenient. This time, I started using Midea's 6-place setting dishwasher. This product was one of the items I was considering among various options! Now that I've actually used it, it's truly a whole new world. First, the size and appearance. It's bigger than I expected. I was worried because the exterior looked like it might be shallow, but after using it, I found that the height is quite tall, so large dishes fit in easily, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it isn't flashy and looks subtly pretty! Performance! I have it set to the standard cycle and am using it by just pressing the power and start buttons. Since the buttons are touch-sensitive, I only need to press them lightly. It was also unique to see the lighting color change depending on the water temperature. It washes using a triple blade system in a 2-tier basket. When using the basket for bulky items like large pots, I found that removing the top basket allowed more items to fit. I use it without the top one. As I stacked them neatly, I felt like a Tetris master now; I'm really good at it! Usually, dishwashers have blades on the top and bottom, but since this one has a triple blade system, it feels like it cleans more thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing is seriously, seriously great. This is important! If the automatic door doesn't work, the dishes dry inside while damp after washing, and I feel like they might start to smell, which really bothers me. I turn on the dishwasher in the morning before leaving for work, and when I come back, the door opens automatically to find the dishes fluffy and dry—it feels so refreshing! The difference between having the automatic door opening feature and not having it is huge! As for the noise! Maybe my 3-place dishwasher was just so noisy, but since using the Midea 6-place dishwasher, it feels like the world has become quiet. It does make a bit of a buzzing sound when the water drains in the middle of the cycle, though. This isn't even noise; it feels more like a notification that it's almost finished. Installation complete! They installed it right through the water purifier connection point without any separate drilling. Once you use a dishwasher, I think it's one of those home appliances you simply can't live without. As a working professional, I am so grateful to have some time to rest thanks to the "Dishwasher Lady." Oh! I think I've saved on gas since using the dishwasher. When I do the dishes by hand, I leave the hot water running the whole time, so I guess that was quite a waste. I am very satisfied with it in many ways! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

I used to have a 3-place setting dishwasher. As a family of three, I used the 3-place setting because I wanted to quickly wash at least the breakfast dishes before heading to work in the morning. However, it was quite inconvenient. This time, I started using Midea's 6-place setting dishwasher. This product was one of the items I was considering among various options! Now that I've actually used it, it's truly a whole new world. First, the size and appearance. It's bigger than I expected. I was worried because the exterior looked like it might be shallow, but after using it, I found that the height is quite tall, so large dishes fit in easily, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it isn't flashy and looks subtly pretty! Performance! I have it set to the standard cycle and am using it by just pressing the power and start buttons. Since the buttons are touch-sensitive, I only need to press them lightly. It was also unique to see the lighting color change depending on the water temperature. It washes using a triple blade system in a 2-tier basket. When using the basket for bulky items like large pots, I found that removing the top basket allowed more items to fit. I use it without the top one. As I stacked them neatly, I felt like a Tetris master now; I'm really good at it! Usually, dishwashers have blades on the top and bottom, but since this one has a triple blade system, it feels like it cleans more thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing is seriously, seriously great. This is important! If the automatic door doesn't work, the dishes dry inside while damp after washing, and I feel like they might start to smell, which really bothers me. I turn on the dishwasher in the morning before leaving for work, and when I come back, the door opens automatically to find the dishes fluffy and dry—it feels so refreshing! The difference between having the automatic door opening feature and not having it is huge! As for the noise! Maybe my 3-place dishwasher was just so noisy, but since using the Midea 6-place dishwasher, it feels like the world has become quiet. It does make a bit of a buzzing sound when the water drains in the middle of the cycle, though. This isn't even noise; it feels more like a notification that it's almost finished. Installation complete! They installed it right through the water purifier connection point without any separate drilling. Once you use a dishwasher, I think it's one of those home appliances you simply can't live without. As a working professional, I am so grateful to have some time to rest thanks to the "Dishwasher Lady." Oh! I think I've saved on gas since using the dishwasher. When I do the dishes by hand, I leave the hot water running the whole time, so I guess that was quite a waste. I am very satisfied with it in many ways! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It has good cleaning power. ] || ---------------- || I think dishwashers are appliances that people agonize over before buying, but once they actually use them, they fall in love with them. I used to have a 3-place setting dishwasher. As a family of three, I used the 3-place setting because I wanted to quickly wash at least the breakfast dishes before heading to work in the morning. However, it was quite inconvenient. This time, I started using Midea's 6-place setting dishwasher. This product was one of the items I was considering among various options! Now that I've actually used it, it's truly a whole new world. First, the size and appearance. It's bigger than I expected. I was worried because the exterior looked like it might be shallow, but after using it, I found that the height is quite tall, so large dishes fit in easily, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it isn't flashy and looks subtly pretty! Performance! I have it set to the standard cycle and am using it by just pressing the power and start buttons. Since the buttons are touch-sensitive, I only need to press them lightly. It was also unique to see the lighting color change depending on the water temperature. It washes using a triple blade system in a 2-tier basket. When using the basket for bulky items like large pots, I found that removing the top basket allowed more items to fit. I use it without the top one. As I stacked them neatly, I felt like a Tetris master now; I'm really good at it! Usually, dishwashers have blades on the top and bottom, but since this one has a triple blade system, it feels like it cleans more thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing is seriously, seriously great. This is important! If the automatic door doesn't work, the dishes dry inside while damp after washing, and I feel like they might start to smell, which really bothers me. I turn on the dishwasher in the morning before leaving for work, and when I come back, the door opens automatically to find the dishes fluffy and dry—it feels so refreshing! The difference between having the automatic door opening feature and not having it is huge! As for the noise! Maybe my 3-place dishwasher was just so noisy, but since using the Midea 6-place dishwasher, it feels like the world has become quiet. It does make a bit of a buzzing sound when the water drains in the middle of the cycle, though. This isn't even noise; it feels more like a notification that it's almost finished. Installation complete! They installed it right through the water purifier connection point without any separate drilling. Once you use a dishwasher, I think it's one of those home appliances you simply can't live without. As a working professional, I am so grateful to have some time to rest thanks to the "Dishwasher Lady." Oh! I think I've saved on gas since using the dishwasher. When I do the dishes by hand, I leave the hot water running the whole time, so I guess that was quite a waste. I am very satisfied with it in many ways! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

I was worried because the exterior looked like it might be shallow, but after using it, I found that the height is quite tall, so large dishes fit in easily, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it isn't flashy and looks subtly pretty! Performance! I have it set to the standard cycle and am using it by just pressing the power and start buttons. Since the buttons are touch-sensitive, I only need to press them lightly. It was also unique to see the lighting color change depending on the water temperature. It washes using a triple blade system in a 2-tier basket. When using the basket for bulky items like large pots, I found that removing the top basket allowed more items to fit. I use it without the top one. As I stacked them neatly, I felt like a Tetris master now; I'm really good at it! Usually, dishwashers have blades on the top and bottom, but since this one has a triple blade system, it feels like it cleans more thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing is seriously, seriously great. This is important! If the automatic door doesn't work, the dishes dry inside while damp after washing, and I feel like they might start to smell, which really bothers me. The difference between having the automatic door opening feature and not having it is huge! As for the noise! Maybe my 3-place dishwasher was just so noisy, but since using the Midea 6-place dishwasher, it feels like the world has become quiet. When I do the dishes by hand, I leave the hot water running the whole time, so I guess that was quite a waste. I am very satisfied with it in many ways! Usually, dishwashers have blades on the top and bottom, but since this one has a triple blade system, it feels like it cleans more thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing is seriously, seriously great. This is important! Comments (English): [ It has good cleaning power. ] || ---------------- || I think dishwashers are appliances that people agonize over before buying, but once they actually use them, they fall in love with them. I used to have a 3-place setting dishwasher. As a family of three, I used the 3-place setting because I wanted to quickly wash at least the breakfast dishes before heading to work in the morning. However, it was quite inconvenient. This time, I started using Midea's 6-place setting dishwasher. This product was one of the items I was considering among various options! Now that I've actually used it, it's truly a whole new world. First, the size and appearance. It's bigger than I expected. I was worried because the exterior looked like it might be shallow, but after using it, I found that the height is quite tall, so large dishes fit in easily, so it's no problem. The blue color is a pastel tone, so it isn't flashy and looks subtly pretty! Performance! I have it set to the standard cycle and am using it by just pressing the power and start buttons. Since the buttons are touch-sensitive, I only need to press them lightly. It was also unique to see the lighting color change depending on the water temperature. It washes using a triple blade system in a 2-tier basket. When using the basket for bulky items like large pots, I found that removing the top basket allowed more items to fit. I use it without the top one. As I stacked them neatly, I felt like a Tetris master now; I'm really good at it! Usually, dishwashers have blades on the top and bottom, but since this one has a triple blade system, it feels like it cleans more thoroughly. The automatic door opening feature after washing is seriously, seriously great. This is important! If the automatic door doesn't work, the dishes dry inside while damp after washing, and I feel like they might start to smell, which really bothers me. I turn on the dishwasher in the morning before leaving for work, and when I come back, the door opens automatically to find the dishes fluffy and dry—it feels so refreshing! The difference between having the automatic door opening feature and not having it is huge! As for the noise! Maybe my 3-place dishwasher was just so noisy, but since using the Midea 6-place dishwasher, it feels like the world has become quiet. It does make a bit of a buzzing sound when the water drains in the middle of the cycle, though. This isn't even noise; it feels more like a notification that it's almost finished. Installation complete! They installed it right through the water purifier connection point without any separate drilling. Once you use a dishwasher, I think it's one of those home appliances you simply can't live without. As a working professional, I am so grateful to have some time to rest thanks to the "Dishwasher Lady." Oh! I think I've saved on gas since using the dishwasher. When I do the dishes by hand, I leave the hot water running the whole time, so I guess that was quite a waste. I am very satisfied with it in many ways! I also need to figure out the proper way to load the dishes. Delivery and installation seem to vary by region. For us, they installed it very meticulously and kindly. Since I can't see the washing process inside, I am curious to see if it is running properly. I expected it to make a rattling sound like a washing machine, but it runs surprisingly quietly—so quietly that I wonder if it is actually cleaning properly. Sentence (English): I finally installed the dishwasher I've been waiting and waiting for!
Comments (English): [ Totally satisfied! A must-have item for pregnant women. ] || ---------------- || I finally installed the dishwasher I've been waiting and waiting for! As I entered my seventh month of pregnancy, doing the dishes became a real chore. I used to leave the dishes piled up all day and have my husband do them in the evening. He told me to buy a dishwasher right away, so I debated a lot between this model and one with a hot air dryer before choosing this one. I expected it to dry the dishes to some extent, but it turned out to be a system that air-dries after everything is done. I looked up all the reviews and saw posts saying that the hot air dryer isn't used much, so I chose this model. It's a bit disappointing, but since it was my own choice, I've let go of the regret! Since I live in a rented apartment, a built-in model wasn't an option, so I looked into a freestanding model for 6 people. Because the kitchen layout has a corner sink, the space for the dishwasher was really awkward, but I just placed it on the countertop, and it seems more usable than I expected! I run the standard cycle when there is no grease, and the powerful cycle when there is grease, and it cleans really well, leaving everything squeaky clean. I pre-wash dishes without any food residue, and there is nothing left to throw away at the bottom, nor are there any water stains. I have been using it for about a week now, and I am truly, truly satisfied. If I anticipate a lot of dishes, I run it once after lunch. I leave the door wide open after running it! It doesn't dry completely by evening, but for a pregnant woman with a big belly, a dishwasher is truly a must-have! My quality of life has skyrocketed. I bought it when the price had dropped a bit, and considering how often I use it, it was a great purchase. +++++++++++ One-Month Review. There are some water stains inside, so I think I need to clean it occasionally. Since it doesn't have a hot air drying function, I actually run it about twice these days. Sentence (English): This has got to be the best dishwasher ever.
Comments (English): [ The Best Dishwasher Ever! ] || ---------------- || This has got to be the best dishwasher ever. Certainly the best one I've ever owned. It is replacing an LG toy, that was just over a year old. My friend recommended Bosch, and I am so glad I listened. The machine is sturdy. The front door opens and closes easily, but you can feel the hinges; sturdy. The three racks are all thoughtfully designed and made of quality material. I ended up taking out the silverware basket and using the third rack for utensils. This gave me more room for our many larger bowls. The machine will let you know when you're low on drying agent (Finish) by displaying a red light on the control panel. The machine is super quiet, which is why it's helpful that it shines a red light on the floor to let you know it's running. The light is small, about an inch in diameter. But helpful. Dishes come out unbelievably clean. So happy with my purchase. Wish I did this years ago.

Sentence (English): I bought and installed a dishwasher for the first time.
Comments (English): [ Samsung Dishwasher Installation Review ] || ---------------- || I bought and installed a dishwasher for the first time. First, on the day of installation, a furniture remodeler came at around 1:00 PM and worked for about an hour. Three hours later, the dishwasher installation technicians came and completed the installation and explained it to me in about 30 minutes. I thought a lot about whether to add a hot air drying function, but there was no problem using it even without the hot air drying function. It's a new world. I highly recommend you try it once. I recommend a 14-person dishwasher because it has more capacity than a 12-person dishwasher. If you want to use it on the same day, prepare a dishwasher-specific detergent. We didn't have a special detergent, so we used it the next day. I think you need to study a little about how to use it. If you turn it on before going to bed at night, it will be completely dry the next morning. I think it takes about an hour and forty minutes. It's not very noisy and it's very convenient to use. The dishwasher delivery and product were very good.
Comments (Original): [ 삼성 식기세척기 설치 후기 ] || ---------------- || 식기세척기 처음으로 구매 후 설치해보았어요.일단 설치 당일 오후 1시쯤 가구 리폼하시는 기사님이 방문하셔서 1시간 정도 작업하셨고, 3시간 뒤에 식기세척기 설치 기사님들 오셔서 30분 정도 걸려서 설치 완료 및 설명해주었어요.열풍건조기능 넣을까 많이 고민햇었는데, 열풍건조 기능 없어도 사용하는데 전혀 문제 없구요. 일단 신세계입니다. 한번 사용해보시길 적극 강추합니다. 12인용보다는 14인용이 용량이 많이 들어가니 14인용 추천합니다. 당일날 사용해보실려면 식기세척기용 전용세제 준비해주세요. 저희는 전용 세제가 없어서 다음날 사용해보았습니다. 사용방법은 조금 공부가 필요할 듯 하구요. 저녁에 자기전에 돌려놓고 자면 다음날 아침에 다 건조 다 되어 있어요. 한시간 사십분정도 시간은 소요되는거 같아요. 소음도 별로 없고, 사용하기 아주 편리합니다.식기세척기 배송 및 상품 아주 좋았어요.

Sentence (English): I wanted to ease the daily burden of washing dishes, save time, and keep my dishes clean, so I researched and purchased a dishwasher.
Comments (English): [ I can enjoy my meals more leisurely. ] || ---------------- || I wanted to ease the daily burden of washing dishes, save time, and keep my dishes clean, so I researched and purchased a dishwasher. I'd been hearing a lot of recommendations for LG dishwashers, and after visiting stores to see them in person, I found the perfect fit and purchased one. I love the ample capacity for 14 people, allowing me to wash a large amount of dishes at once, even when I have large families or guests over. Furthermore, the Objet Collection's sleek design perfectly complements my kitchen interior, which made me even more impressed. The ample storage space allowed me to load dishes, plates, and pots all at once, eliminating the need for repeated turns. The adjustable internal shelves allowed me to efficiently organize dishes of various sizes. This allowed me to focus on dishes on a regular basis, while also washing larger pots and plates on special occasions without a problem. The powerful water flow and thorough cleaning function completely removed grease and stuck-on food residue. I especially enjoyed the feeling of thorough cleaning, and the results were incomparably cleaner than washing dishes by hand. I was satisfied with the fact that I used detergent and conditioner together, so there were almost no water marks left after rinsing, and I was amazed at how shiny the dishes looked. Sentence (English): A 3-tier washing system for wider and cleaner cleaning.
Comments (English): A 3-tier washing system for wider and cleaner cleaning. A powerful washing system consisting of a total of three washing blades—top, middle, and bottom—maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring thorough cleaning without blind spots. Top washing blade (a rotating blade on the ceiling sprays water to clean dishes in the top tray). Middle washing blade (a blade attached to the wall sprays water to clean between dishes without gaps). Single-tier dual washing blade (two blades rotate and spray water to clean dishes in the bottom tray). The Midea dishwasher cleans even troublesome items like grease and hard sauces quickly and neatly. Three pastel colors to choose from to match your interior. Automatic door opening function to eliminate worries about moisture and odors. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to quickly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. The generously sized 2-tier basket allows for storage of everything from small dishes to large frying pans at once. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The LED display changes color according to the water temperature. You can add dishes to wash even if the dishwasher is already in operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash courses, allowing you to choose the one that best suits your needs. Dry (a course for rinsing and drying with hot water). Sentence (English): I have been freed from the hell of dishwashing.
Comments (English): [ I have some spare time. ] || ---------------- || I have been freed from the hell of dishwashing. Actually, I had been debating whether or not to buy a dishwasher since last year. My kitchen space is a bit awkward; if I installed one, the sink would become too small, leaving no room to use it while cooking. I wanted to buy one, but I hesitated because I didn't know where to put it, so I ended up not buying one, and a friend did. She highly recommended it, saying she was very satisfied after using it, but I just kept thinking about it and ended up leaving it in my shopping cart. My wrists and shoulders ached, dishes kept piling up every day, and I couldn't escape the kitchen all day long. Stress just kept building up, so I finally just went for it. Luckily, I got card and coupon discounts, so it was affordable, and I couldn't hesitate any longer. I figured I could manage in this small space somehow, but I felt that if I missed this opportunity, the price would go up and I wouldn't be able to buy it, so I just went ahead and bought it. It’s so good! It does take a little time, but since I don't have to be the only one stuck in the kitchen doing the dishes after meals, I don't have to blame my family, which is great. I hurriedly bought detergent via Rocket Delivery and ran it right away. It isn't very noisy, and actually, it doesn't seem to use much water. It seems to use less water than when I just leave it running while washing dishes. It has an automatic door opening feature, so it opens when it finishes, allowing you to run it without worry and go out. However, since there is no hot air drying function, the items didn't dry completely. It uses a self-drying method where hot water is sprayed at the end, but even with the door open, water remains on bowls (not flat plates or dishes). So, I take them out and run the self-drying function once the heat has dissipated. The cleaning power is good; since it uses hot water, grease is removed effectively. It's so convenient because it makes things so much easier. I tend to eat a lot of meat, so I am satisfied. It feels like I have more free time now. I usually run it in the morning or evening, or about twice a day when there is a lot of food. Since the kids eat late at night, there used to be a pile of dishes when I woke up, which was stressful having to do the dishes right after waking up. But running it after breakfast makes me not angry anymore. The only slight drawback for me is that I need to soak the leftovers before washing them all at once; having the dishes in the sink makes it a bit inconvenient when doing other cooking tasks or kitchen chores. Sentence (English): I bought the Ascenta model a few yrs ago, thinking that the Bosch brand was a durable and reliable brand.
Comments (English): [ Not durable ] || ---------------- || I bought the Ascenta model a few yrs ago, thinking that the Bosch brand was a durable and reliable brand. Just a few months after the one year warranty ran out, it stopped working. It would not even turn on. I checked everything I could and everything looked good. Knowing that a repair would cost nearly the same as replacing it, I chose to replace it after 1st buying a new control board ( it wasn't very much, $50 ) and trying that. Looking at the control board, I realized how poorly the thing is made. The cheapest parts that Bosch could find. So what did I buy, another Bosch 100. I guess I'm a glutton for punishment. But the new one has been working fine. It cleans and dries well, and it is quiet. I'm crossing my fingers that the 1st one I got was a dud and Bosch used crappy components for that one, and this newer one has improved components. I'll see I guess.

Sentence (English): LG never again I recently bought an LG dishwasher and have had issues with draining since purchase with noticeable soap in the tub after the cycle.
Comments (English): [ LG never again ] || ---------------- || LG never again I recently bought an LG dishwasher and have had issues with draining since purchase with noticeable soap in the tub after the cycle. I tried troubleshooting the soap bubble issue by washing on high temp, making sure I first ran the sink faucet on high temp before starting a dish cycle, adding citric acid to a wash, and trying liquid dishwasher soap instead of gel packets. I finally resorted to running the dishwasher twice so my family wasn't eating soap with every dish. I tried everything I read about then finally decided to leave more food on the dishes like recommended to see if that would help break down the soap suds during a wash. After a week of trying that, I got an OE error meaning draining issue. My husband and I did the suggestions for OE error including checking the air gap and trying to restart the dishwasher. We pulled the dishwasher out of the cabinet and noticed the drain hose was pinched. From what the pinch looked like, I assumed the hose got pinched when it was installed. The dishwasher was installed by one technician that Costco had sent. All of the previous Costco appliances I have bought have been installed by two technicians. For this dishwasher installation, there was just one installer on his own and he told me he had a very busy day with eight appliances to install that day. After I got the OE drain error that wouldn't go away, I contacted the Costco chat for help. I was told by the Costco chat person that because it had been more than 100 days since purchase it was now a warranty issue I needed to contact LG about. Frustratingly it was still less than 100 days since delivery, just more than 100 days since I bought the dishwasher. I contacted the LG help line that Costco gave me and described the issue and that I thought the hose was damaged during installation. I sent the LG chat help a picture of the issue. They set up a day (an entire 24 hour window of time) that a technician would come out to my house. The LG help line didn't forward the photo to the technician so when he came to my house and looked at the dishwasher, he told me he would need to order a hose which should take a few days. He didn't do any trouble shooting like turning on the dishwasher. A couple days later he sent me a text telling me that his boss said that since the hose was damaged during a bad installation (which was simply my assumption, not something that could actually be verified or disproved at this point), LG wouldn't cover the repair. I have bought four large LG appliances from Costco in the past two years, but I will not be buying another LG product. Whether the drain hose was damaged during installation like I assumed, I would have hoped that either Costco or LG could have replaced the hose or made the issue good. The hose would probably cost a dollar or two to manufacture, a small cost LG or Costco could have covered and still made profit from my business and kept a satisfied customer. At this point I wish I could return this LG dishwasher and simply get my old Whirlpool dishwasher back. I am leaving this review to encourage anyone who purchases an appliance to be proactive with issues that occur. And to not make my mistake by telling LG what you assumed might have happened to the appliance. Let LG troubleshoot and make their own conclusions.

They set up a day (an entire 24 hour window of time) that a technician would come out to my house. The LG help line didn't forward the photo to the technician so when he came to my house and looked at the dishwasher, he told me he would need to order a hose which should take a few days. Comments (English): [ Installation service needs improvement ] || ---------------- || I was really looking forward to this new Bosch dishwasher. All they had to do is to sham it with a small piece of wood and it should be fine. But, no, I was told that that's not their job. I then called Costco customer service (or the lack thereof) for solutions, and it was even worse. I was told that there is nothing they can do to, and it's my house's fault. Oh well, I guess the only option for me is to return it. I then bought another Bosch from a local shop. One installer from the shop replaced the dishwasher in 30 minutes. That is the difference between armatures and professionals. I normally like Costco products and services. In fact, I like it so much that I am a shareholder of Costco. For the sake of the business and my Costco shares, Costco should really look into improving its installation services. Always going with the cheapest contractors does not pay. It may be worthwhile to have in-house installers so the installation training, process, and quality can be better controlled. Otherwise, Costco will end up with lots of returned products and unhappy customers.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.
Comments (Original): [ 가성비와 디자인을 모두 잡은 6인용 식세기 ] || ---------------- || 내돈내산 후기입니다.신혼 가전으로 식세기 이모님을 찾고있었는데, 전세집이라 제약이 아주 많았습니다.하부장을 해체할 수가 없어서 싱크대 위에 설치하는 6인용으로 가야했고, 공간도 큰 식세기는 못들어가서 슬림한 식세기를 찾아야 했습니다.상판 타공도 허락은 받긴 했는데 가급적 타공 없이 설치하고 싶었고, 무설치형은 물 채우는 게 번거로워서 급수 호스를 타공 없이 설치 가능한 식세기를 찾아야 했습니다. 그래서 찾은게 이 친구입니다.이 식세기의 특징은 다음과 같습니다.1. 6인용 식세기 전문 회사2. 슬림한 사이즈3. 상황에 따라 무타공 가능4. 깔끔한 디자인5. 2단인데 1단 가능6. 자동 문열림7. 스테인리스 내부특징들을 자세히 살펴보면,1. 6인용 식세기 전문 회사미디어는 믿을 수 있는 식세기 전문 회사입니다. 중국 브랜드라 생소할 수 있는데, 삼성이나 다른 중소기업 식세기 제조사가 미디어입니다.재미있는건 미디어에서 만든 식세기와 국내 브랜드가 미디어에 위탁 생산한 식세기를 비교해보면 어딘가 비슷하게 생겼습니다. 기본 프레임을 공유하는  것 같습니다.그런데 미디어가 10만원 이상 싸니 미디어를 사는게 이득이죠.2. 슬림한 사이즈6인용 식세기는 옆으로 크고 높이가 상대적으로 낮은 1단짜리와 높이를 좀 올리고 슬림하게 만든 2단짜리가 있습니다. 이녀석은 2단으로 올리고 깊이를 줄였습니다.저희집 싱크대는 깊이가 50이 안되는데, 1단짜리 뚱뚱한 친구들은 기본이 50입니다. 그래서 슬림한 식세기가 필요했고, 이 친구는 사이즈가 맞더라구요.3. 무타공 가능이 식세기는 무설치가 아니라 타공을 해야합니다. 급수호스를 배수관에 연결해야 하기 때문인데, 전세집은 타공이 어렵습니다. 그래서 여러 후기를 찾아보니 하부장 걸레받이 쪽에 틈이 있으면 그쪽으로 급수 호스를 넣어서 설치를 하더라구요.다행히 저희 집 하부장도 틈이 있어서 설치기사님에게 요청드렸고, 타공 없이 설치를 진행했습니다.4. 깔끔한 디자인솔직히 미디어 다른 식세기들은 못생겼습니다. 그런데 이 식세기는 디자인이 양호합니다. 주방에 놓을건데 디자인이 구리면 용서가 안됩니다. 미디어 로고만 흐린 눈 하면 문제 없이 쓸 수 있는 디자인입니다.5. 1단 가능이 식세기는 2단입니다. 2단 식세기는 기본적으로 1단보다 넓이가 넓지 않습니다. 게다가 2단 트레이 때문에 큰거를 못넣는게 아주 치명적입니다.그런데 다행히도 이 친구는 2단 트레이가 빠집니다. 큰 접시같은 것들은 2단 트레이를 빼고 돌릴 수 있습니다.6. 자동 문열림식세기에서 가장 중요한 기능같습니다. 세척이 끝나고 습기를 빼야하는데, 자동 문열림이 있으면 습기가 잘 빠집니다. 열풍건조까지 있으면 완벽하지만, 자동 문열림이 있기 때문에 없어도 불편하지는 않습니다.7. 스테인리스 내부싼 식세기는 내부가 내열 플라스틱입니다. 플라스틱의 단점은 물방울이 맺힙니다. LG 6인용을 안산 이유가 윗부분이 플라스틱이어서 였습니다.이 친구는 벽과 윗부분 모두 스텐입니다. (밑에는 일부 플라스틱이긴 한데, 이것은 문제가 되지 않습니다.)단점도 몇가지 있습니다.1. 소음이 약간 있습니다. 12인용에 비하면 6인용은 구조상 소음이 있는게 어쩔 수 없습니다. 세척 소리는 크게 안거슬리는데, 두번 정도 조금 큰 소음이 들리는 구간이 있습니다. (길지는 않습니다.)2. 경우에 따라 물때가 약간 생깁니다. 프로쉬 세제를 반 잘라서 쓰고 린스는 안쓰는데, 그래서 그런지 놔두면 물때가 약간 생깁니다. 투명 유리에서 잘 보이는 것 같습니다.3. 문 열리는 구조상 앞 공간이 문 길이만큼 필요합니다. 저희 집은 수전이 걸려서 어쩔 수 없이 활짝 열지 못하는 상태로 쓰고 있습니다.총평을 하자면, 슬림한 6인용 식세기를 찾고 있다면 이녀석입니다. 타공이 가능하면 베스트고, 불가능하면 급수 호스를 뺄 수 있는 곳이 있는지 꼭 확인해보시고 기사님과 상의해서 설치하시기 바랍니다.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.
