I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.
