Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that offers both value and design. ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a dishwasher I bought with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher for my newlywed home, but since it was a rental house, there were a lot of restrictions. Since I couldn't disassemble the lower cabinet, I had to go with a 6-person dishwasher that was installed above the sink. And since a large dishwasher wouldn't fit in the space, I had to find a slim dishwasher. I did get permission to drill holes in the top panel, but I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. And since filling the non-installed type was a hassle, I had to find a dishwasher that I could install the water hose without drilling holes. That's why I found this guy. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. Drill-free operation is possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. 2-tier but can be used as a single-tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Let's take a closer look at the features. 1. A company specializing in 6-person dishwashers. Media is a trustworthy dishwasher company. It might seem unfamiliar because it's a Chinese brand, but Samsung and other small and medium-sized dishwasher manufacturers are called Media. What's interesting is that if you compare the dishwashers made by Media with those produced by domestic brands that are contracted to Media, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Media is over 100,000 won cheaper, it's more advantageous to buy Media. 2. Slim size: There are two types of 6-person dishwashers: a single-tier type that is tall and relatively short, and a two-tier type that is taller and slimmer. This one has two tiers and is shallower. The sink in my house is less than 50cm deep, but the standard for fat single-tier dishes is 50cm. So I needed a slim dishwasher, and this one is the right size. 3. Non-drilling: This dishwasher does not require installation; you have to drill a hole. This is because the water supply hose needs to be connected to the drain pipe, and drilling is difficult in a rented house. So I looked up several reviews and found that if there is a gap near the mop holder in the lower cabinet, the water hose should be inserted there for installation. Fortunately, my lower cabinet also had a gap, so I asked the installer and he proceeded with the installation without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Media dishwashers are ugly. But this dishwasher has a good design. If you are going to put it in the kitchen, it is unforgivable if the design is old. If you have a blurred eye for the Media logo, it is a design that can be used without any problems. 5. Single-tier possible This dishwasher has two tiers. Two-tier dishwashers are basically not wider than the single-tier. Moreover, the fact that you cannot put in large items because of the second-tier tray is a critical problem. Fortunately, this guy has a removable second-tier tray. You can remove the second-tier tray and turn it to put in large dishes. 6. Auto door opening. This seems to be the most important feature in a dishwasher. After washing, you need to let out the moisture, and the automatic door opening helps the moisture to be let out well. It would be perfect if it had a hot air dryer, but it's not inconvenient even without it because it has an automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior: Cheap dishwashers have heat-resistant plastic interiors. The downside of plastic is that it tends to collect water droplets. I didn't buy the LG 6-seater because the top was made of plastic. This one has stainless steel walls and tops (there is some plastic on the bottom, but that's not a problem). There are a few downsides: 1. It's a little noisy. Compared to the 12-seater, the 6-seater is structurally noisy. The washing sound isn't that bothersome, but there are a couple of periods where you can hear a little bit of noise (not for long). 2. Sometimes, water stains appear. I cut the Prosh detergent in half and don't use conditioner, so if I leave it alone, water stains appear a little. It seems to be easily visible through the transparent glass. 3. The door needs the same amount of space in front as the door to open. My house has a water faucet that's stuck, so I can't open it all the way. Overall, if you're looking for a slim, six-person dishwasher, this is it. If drilling holes are possible, that's best. If not, make sure there's a place to remove the water hose, and consult with a technician before installing.

Comments (English): [ It's a whole new world! ^^ ] || ---------------- || When I started my own business, I was so tired from taking care of the kids, doing housework, and running a business that it was no easy task to just wash the dishes that piled up when I got home. So I was worried about whether I should buy a dishwasher, whether it would wash the dishes cleanly, and whether it would be a needless hassle. But I was searching frantically with the thought that I should buy one, and a great opportunity called Coupang Experience Group came up, so I chose this product right away! ^^After 10 years of being a housewife, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time~^^ The technician finally arrived and installed it, but it took longer than I thought;; Since we don't have any cords at home, he said he would make one, so I think it took about an hour^^ After the installation was finally finished, he gave me a detailed explanation and I immediately started loading the dishes and turning it on~ Oh my, I really look like a beginner. If you arrange the dishes well, you can wash them cleanly and load a lot of them. I put the dishes back in, put the spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, pour in the detergent, close the door, press the power button, select the cycle, and press the play button! It was so simple. I'm not good at machines, so complicated things are my fault, but I was able to use it so simply and cleanly! ~It's spacious inside, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a much better space utilization than the existing shelf! ^^The hole for the dishwasher hose was made as small as possible, so it's barely visible, and most of all, the dishwasher is so pretty! I like ivory, but I think other colors would be pretty too because they're pastel tones~ I put all the dishes in a neat arrangement right before I go to work and turn it on, and the automatic door opening function automatically expels the humid air, so I don't have to worry about anything and I love it! ~ When I get home, all the smell and moisture are gone, and I just take out the clean dishes and put them away! ~ One less chore is done, and it's so convenient! I wonder why I didn't do it sooner ;; I put in enough detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there's a lot of grease, I use the strong cycle, so even the grease is cleanly removed! I'm so touched that the washing wings are on the top, middle, and bottom, so I think it washes even more thoroughly! ~ I didn't know it could even be done this well between the dishes! ^^ The basket is spacious with two levels, so if you organize it well, you can really hold a lot~ Except for that pot, I finished washing all the dishes I used all day in one go! ~The LED display and touch control are so pretty and well designed for safe operation, and the light color changes from blue when the water temperature is below 60 degrees during washing to red when it is above 60 degrees. Even these are so pretty and useful functions! ^^ It is convenient and satisfying to be able to add dishes during washing! ^^ I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click the Helpful button! ^^ This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of a Coupang Experience Group event.

I put the dishes back in, put the spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, pour in the detergent, close the door, press the power button, select the cycle, and press the play button! It was so simple. I'm not good at machines, so complicated things are my fault, but I was able to use it so simply and cleanly! ~It's spacious inside, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. I wonder why I didn't do it sooner ;; I put in enough detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there's a lot of grease, I use the strong cycle, so even the grease is cleanly removed! It was so simple. I'm not good at machines, so complicated things are my fault, but I was able to use it so simply and cleanly! ~It's spacious inside, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a much better space utilization than the existing shelf! ^^The hole for the dishwasher hose was made as small as possible, so it's barely visible, and most of all, the dishwasher is so pretty! I like ivory, but I think other colors would be pretty too because they're pastel tones~ I put all the dishes in a neat arrangement right before I go to work and turn it on, and the automatic door opening function automatically expels the humid air, so I don't have to worry about anything and I love it! ~ When I get home, all the smell and moisture are gone, and I just take out the clean dishes and put them away! ~ One less chore is done, and it's so convenient! I wonder why I didn't do it sooner ;; I put in enough detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there's a lot of grease, I use the strong cycle, so even the grease is cleanly removed! I'm so touched that the washing wings are on the top, middle, and bottom, so I think it washes even more thoroughly! ~ I didn't know it could even be done this well between the dishes! ^^ The basket is spacious with two levels, so if you organize it well, you can really hold a lot~ Except for that pot, I finished washing all the dishes I used all day in one go! ~The LED display and touch control are so pretty and well designed for safe operation, and the light color changes from blue when the water temperature is below 60 degrees during washing to red when it is above 60 degrees. Comments (English): [ It's a whole new world! ^^ ] || ---------------- || When I started my own business, I was so tired from taking care of the kids, doing housework, and running a business that it was no easy task to just wash the dishes that piled up when I got home. If you arrange the dishes well, you can wash them cleanly and load a lot of them. I put the dishes back in, put the spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, pour in the detergent, close the door, press the power button, select the cycle, and press the play button! It was so simple. I'm not good at machines, so complicated things are my fault, but I was able to use it so simply and cleanly! ~It's spacious inside, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a much better space utilization than the existing shelf! ^^The hole for the dishwasher hose was made as small as possible, so it's barely visible, and most of all, the dishwasher is so pretty! I like ivory, but I think other colors would be pretty too because they're pastel tones~ I put all the dishes in a neat arrangement right before I go to work and turn it on, and the automatic door opening function automatically expels the humid air, so I don't have to worry about anything and I love it! ~ When I get home, all the smell and moisture are gone, and I just take out the clean dishes and put them away! ~ One less chore is done, and it's so convenient! I wonder why I didn't do it sooner ;; I put in enough detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there's a lot of grease, I use the strong cycle, so even the grease is cleanly removed! I'm so touched that the washing wings are on the top, middle, and bottom, so I think it washes even more thoroughly! ~ I didn't know it could even be done this well between the dishes! ^^ The basket is spacious with two levels, so if you organize it well, you can really hold a lot~ Except for that pot, I finished washing all the dishes I used all day in one go! ~The LED display and touch control are so pretty and well designed for safe operation, and the light color changes from blue when the water temperature is below 60 degrees during washing to red when it is above 60 degrees. Even these are so pretty and useful functions! ^^ It is convenient and satisfying to be able to add dishes during washing! ^^ I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! Comments (English): [ It's a whole new world! ^^ ] || ---------------- || When I started my own business, I was so tired from taking care of the kids, doing housework, and running a business that it was no easy task to just wash the dishes that piled up when I got home. If you arrange the dishes well, you can wash them cleanly and load a lot of them. I put the dishes back in, put the spoons and chopsticks in the spoon holder, pour in the detergent, close the door, press the power button, select the cycle, and press the play button! It was so simple. I'm not good at machines, so complicated things are my fault, but I was able to use it so simply and cleanly! ~It's spacious inside, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. I like ivory, but I think other colors would be pretty too because they're pastel tones~ I put all the dishes in a neat arrangement right before I go to work and turn it on, and the automatic door opening function automatically expels the humid air, so I don't have to worry about anything and I love it! ~ When I get home, all the smell and moisture are gone, and I just take out the clean dishes and put them away! ~ One less chore is done, and it's so convenient! I wonder why I didn't do it sooner ;; I put in enough detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there's a lot of grease, I use the strong cycle, so even the grease is cleanly removed! I'm so touched that the washing wings are on the top, middle, and bottom, so I think it washes even more thoroughly! ~ I didn't know it could even be done this well between the dishes! ^^ The basket is spacious with two levels, so if you organize it well, you can really hold a lot~ Except for that pot, I finished washing all the dishes I used all day in one go! ~The LED display and touch control are so pretty and well designed for safe operation, and the light color changes from blue when the water temperature is below 60 degrees during washing to red when it is above 60 degrees. Sentence (English): This is a review of a product I purchased with my own money.
Comments (English): [ A 6-person dishwasher that captures both value for money and design ] || ---------------- || This is a review of a product I purchased with my own money. I was looking for a dishwasher as a new home appliance, but since I live in a rented apartment, there were many restrictions. I couldn't remove the base cabinets, so I had to go with a 6-place setting model that installs above the sink. Also, a large dishwasher wouldn't fit, so I had to find a slim one. Although I did get permission to drill a hole in the countertop, I wanted to install it without drilling if possible. Since filling water is a hassle with non-installation models, I needed to find a dishwasher where the water supply hose could be installed without drilling. That is how I found this one. The features of this dishwasher are as follows: 1. A company specializing in 6-place setting dishwashers. 2. Slim size. 3. No-drilling possible depending on the situation. 4. Clean design. 5. It is a 2-tier model, but can be operated as a single tier. 6. Automatic door opening. 7. Stainless steel interior. Looking at the features in detail: 1. A company specializing in 6-place setting dishwashers. Midea is a trustworthy company specializing in dishwashers. It might be unfamiliar because it is a Chinese brand, but Midea is the manufacturer of dishwashers for Samsung and other small to medium-sized companies. Interestingly, if you compare the dishwasher made by Midea with one produced by domestic brands under contract by Midea, they look somewhat similar. It seems they share the same basic frame. However, since Midea is over 100,000 won cheaper, it is more advantageous to buy the Midea model. 2. Slim size. 6-place setting dishwashers come in two types: single-tier models that are wide and relatively low, and two-tier models that are taller and slimmer. So, after looking at various reviews, I found that if there is a gap near the baseboard of the lower cabinet, people install it by threading the water supply hose through there. Fortunately, there was a gap in my base cabinet, so I requested it from the installer, and the installation proceeded without drilling. 4. Clean design. Honestly, other Midea dishwashers are ugly. However, this dishwasher has a decent design. Since it is going to be placed in the kitchen, I cannot forgive a bad design. As long as you overlook the Midea logo, the design is fine to use. 5. Single-tier capability. This dishwasher is a two-tier model. Two-tier dishwashers are generally not wider than single-tier models. Furthermore, the inability to fit large items due to the second-tier tray is a critical drawback. Fortunately, however, the second-tier tray on this model is removable. You can remove the tray to wash large dishes. 6. Automatic door opening. This seems to be the most important feature of a dishwasher. You need to remove moisture after washing, and the automatic door opening allows for efficient moisture drainage. It would be perfect if it also had a hot air drying function, but since it has the automatic door opening, it is not inconvenient without it. 7. Stainless steel interior. Cheap dishwashers have interiors made of heat-resistant plastic. The downside of plastic is that water droplets form. The reason I didn't buy the LG 6-place setting model was because the top part was plastic. This model features stainless steel walls and a top. (The bottom is partially plastic, but this isn't an issue.) There are a few downsides as well. 1. It is slightly noisy. Compared to the 12-place setting model, some noise is unavoidable for the 6-place setting due to its design. The wash sound isn't particularly bothersome, but there are a couple of moments where a slightly louder noise is heard (it doesn't last long). 2. Depending on the situation, some limescale may form. I cut the Frosh detergent in half and don't use rinse aid; perhaps because of this, some limescale builds up if left unattended. It seems to be quite visible through the clear glass. 3. Due to the door opening mechanism, space equal to the length of the door is required in front. In my house, the faucet gets in the way, so I have no choice but to use it with the door not fully open. In summary, if you are looking for a slim 6-place setting dishwasher, this is the one. It is best if a hole can be drilled; if not, please make sure to check if there is a place to run the water supply hose and consult with the technician before installation.

Comments (English): [ It's seriously a whole new world! ^^ ] || ---------------- || Since starting my own business, juggling childcare, housework, and running the shop, I was physically exhausted. Coming home and doing the piled-up dishes was no easy task. I wondered if I should buy a dishwasher, but I was worried it would actually clean well or just be a hassle. Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! I learned that you have to arrange the dishes properly to get them clean and load a lot of them. So, I put the full stack of dishes back in, placed the cutlery in the holder, added detergent, closed the door, pressed the power button, selected the cycle, and pressed the play button! It is the very definition of simplicity. As someone who is completely clueless about machines, I absolutely hate anything complicated, but I was able to operate it in a super simple and clean manner! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! It is convenient to be able to add dishes while washing, and I feel so satisfied! I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! Coming home and doing the piled-up dishes was no easy task. I wondered if I should buy a dishwasher, but I was worried it would actually clean well or just be a hassle. Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! I learned that you have to arrange the dishes properly to get them clean and load a lot of them. So, I put the full stack of dishes back in, placed the cutlery in the holder, added detergent, closed the door, pressed the power button, selected the cycle, and pressed the play button! It is the very definition of simplicity. As someone who is completely clueless about machines, I absolutely hate anything complicated, but I was able to operate it in a super simple and clean manner! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! It is convenient to be able to add dishes while washing, and I feel so satisfied! I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Coming home and doing the piled-up dishes was no easy task. I wondered if I should buy a dishwasher, but I was worried it would actually clean well or just be a hassle. Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! I learned that you have to arrange the dishes properly to get them clean and load a lot of them. So, I put the full stack of dishes back in, placed the cutlery in the holder, added detergent, closed the door, pressed the power button, selected the cycle, and pressed the play button! It is the very definition of simplicity. As someone who is completely clueless about machines, I absolutely hate anything complicated, but I was able to operate it in a super simple and clean manner! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! It is convenient to be able to add dishes while washing, and I feel so satisfied! I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Coming home and doing the piled-up dishes was no easy task. I wondered if I should buy a dishwasher, but I was worried it would actually clean well or just be a hassle. Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! I learned that you have to arrange the dishes properly to get them clean and load a lot of them. So, I put the full stack of dishes back in, placed the cutlery in the holder, added detergent, closed the door, pressed the power button, selected the cycle, and pressed the play button! It is the very definition of simplicity. As someone who is completely clueless about machines, I absolutely hate anything complicated, but I was able to operate it in a super simple and clean manner! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! It is convenient to be able to add dishes while washing, and I feel so satisfied! I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's seriously a whole new world! ^^ ] || ---------------- || Since starting my own business, juggling childcare, housework, and running the shop, I was physically exhausted. Coming home and doing the piled-up dishes was no easy task. I wondered if I should buy a dishwasher, but I was worried it would actually clean well or just be a hassle. Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! I learned that you have to arrange the dishes properly to get them clean and load a lot of them. So, I put the full stack of dishes back in, placed the cutlery in the holder, added detergent, closed the door, pressed the power button, selected the cycle, and pressed the play button! It is the very definition of simplicity. As someone who is completely clueless about machines, I absolutely hate anything complicated, but I was able to operate it in a super simple and clean manner! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! It is convenient to be able to add dishes while washing, and I feel so satisfied! I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Coming home and doing the piled-up dishes was no easy task. I wondered if I should buy a dishwasher, but I was worried it would actually clean well or just be a hassle. Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! I learned that you have to arrange the dishes properly to get them clean and load a lot of them. So, I put the full stack of dishes back in, placed the cutlery in the holder, added detergent, closed the door, pressed the power button, selected the cycle, and pressed the play button! It is the very definition of simplicity. As someone who is completely clueless about machines, I absolutely hate anything complicated, but I was able to operate it in a super simple and clean manner! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! It is convenient to be able to add dishes while washing, and I feel so satisfied! I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): [ It's seriously a whole new world! ^^ ] || ---------------- || Since starting my own business, juggling childcare, housework, and running the shop, I was physically exhausted. Coming home and doing the piled-up dishes was no easy task. I wondered if I should buy a dishwasher, but I was worried it would actually clean well or just be a hassle. Despite these concerns, I was determined to buy one and was frantically searching online when a great opportunity to join the Coupang Experience Group came up, so I immediately chose this product! As a housewife of 10 years, I was so excited to finally use a dishwasher for the first time. The technician finally arrived and started the installation, but it took longer than I expected. Since our house didn't have a power cord, it took about an hour for them to make one. Once the installation was finished and they explained everything in detail, I immediately threw in a bunch of dishes and started the machine. Oh my, I really showed my inexperience! I learned that you have to arrange the dishes properly to get them clean and load a lot of them. So, I put the full stack of dishes back in, placed the cutlery in the holder, added detergent, closed the door, pressed the power button, selected the cycle, and pressed the play button! It is the very definition of simplicity. As someone who is completely clueless about machines, I absolutely hate anything complicated, but I was able to operate it in a super simple and clean manner! The interior is spacious, but the dishwasher is so slim and pretty that it doesn't take up much space. It's a huge upgrade in space utilization compared to my old shelf! They drilled a minimal hole for the hose so it is barely visible and looks neat. Above all, the dishwasher is so pretty! It is my favorite ivory color, but I think the other colors would be lovely too since they are pastel tones. Just before leaving for work, I arranged all the dishes nicely, put them in, and turned it on. Thanks to the automatic door opening function, it vents out the humid air on its own, so I don't have to worry about anything afterwards—it's so great! When I got home, I just took out the clean dishes with all the smell and humidity completely removed and tidied them up in a flash! It reduced one chore, and I can't believe how convenient it is! I wondered why I hadn't gotten this sooner. I put in plenty of detergent according to the amount of dishes, and when there was a lot of grease, I used the powerful cycle, and it removed even the grease perfectly! I'm truly impressed. With washing blades located at the top, middle, and bottom, it seems like the cleaning is done even more thoroughly! I didn't expect it to clean even between the dishes this well! The basket is generously sized with two tiers, so if you arrange them well, you can really fit a lot in. Excluding pots, I was able to wash all the dishes I used all day in one go using the dishwasher! The LED display and touch controls are so pretty and well-designed for safe operation. The lighting changes color during washing—blue if the water temperature is below 60 degrees and red if it is above 60 degrees—and even this is such a pretty and useful feature! It is convenient to be able to add dishes while washing, and I feel so satisfied! I am leaving a genuine review to help you with your purchase! If my review was helpful, please click "Helpful"! This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Bottle holders are great for us.
Comments (English): [ Great Dishwasher ] || ---------------- || Bottle holders are great for us. Hubby is a biker and with the old one bottles had to be tilted. Never felt like they were clean. Only drawback to the bottle feature is that you have to lower the middle tier down a notch for the bottles to stand up in place. Long tongs and turners have to be washed on the top (3rd) rack. Drying is fine-- I wash at night and they're pretty much dry the next morning and I don't use the heated mode.No cons-- just be careful that you don't set or reset the settings when you open and close the door. Top settings are pretty when the door is closed because they're invisible, but you just have to watch putting your hand there absentmindedly.Love the model.

Comments (English): [ Extremely Disappointing Experience with LG ] || ---------------- || I regret purchasing an LG dishwasher directly from their official website due to the incredibly unprofessional delivery and installation experience. When I made the purchase, the website clearly stated that all basic installation parts would be included. However, when the dishwasher was delivered, I was informed that the installation couldn't proceed because I needed to buy granite brackets, which was never mentioned beforehand. Additionally, after the old dishwasher was removed, there was significant water leakage, which led to them refusing to remove the old unit, claiming that was part of the service.After being shown the required brackets, I ordered them right away, but the first installation team left the new dishwasher in the middle of my living room without installing it. The second attempt was a no-show with no explanation, and on the third attempt, I was told the granite brackets were too large, and I needed to order new ones. They also claimed the dishwasher didn't come with an installation kit and that I needed to buy that as well. They once again left the dishwasher in the middle of my room, but at least they removed the old unit and promised the water leakage issue was fixed.A few days later, I discovered water damage to my kitchen cabinet and hardwood floor, and even worse, my downstairs neighbors began complaining about a wet ceiling. After a month of back-and-forth with LG, I decided to return the dishwasher.In conclusion, I strongly advise against purchasing appliances directly from LG due to their subpar delivery and installation service. If you do want an LG appliance, I highly recommend buying it from a reputable retailer instead.

Comments (English): [ It's a new world ] || ---------------- || I've been hearing a lot about the dishwasher lately. Comments (English): 1. Purchase. It's true that every housewife dreams of owning a dishwasher! Even though I used excuses like "my kitchen space is limited because I live in an old apartment" and "I can just do the dishes myself," I always secretly wanted one. The only thing I couldn't quite get used to was that it takes longer than I expected. However, I soon adapted and decided to just live more comfortably with it. It feels like I’ve discovered a whole new world. The automatic door opening feature means I don't have to worry about humidity or odors, and I also like how it quickly expels hot, humid air. It seems perfect for those with limited sink space or for a family of three. I recommend the Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place) to anyone who hasn't used a dishwasher yet, as it offers great value for money. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through a Coupang Experience Group event.
Comments (Original): 1.구매주부라면 누구나 식기세척기에 대한 로망이 있는거 맞죠!..오래된 아파트라서 주방공간이 넉넉하지 않다는 핑계, 설거지는 그냥 내가 하면 되지 라는 생각이 있음에도 마음 한켠에는 식세기를 가지고 싶은 마음이 늘 있었는데 쿠팡에서 좋은 기회로 미디어 자동문열림 식기세척기 6인용을 체험하게 되었습니다.2.배송주문한 다음 날 설치기사님과 전화로 시간 약속을 했습니다. 약속한 오전 9시 45분쯤 도착하셔서 10시 30분쯤 설치 완료했습니다.호수 구멍 하나 뚫어서 설치 완료 하고 식세기 사용 설명까지 친절하게 해 주셨습니다.빠른배송 빠른설치 완벽합니다.3.사용색상이 너무 예뻐서 설레는 마음으로 저녁 식사 후 식기세척기를 처음으로 사용했습니다.약간의 소음은 있네요.제가 하는 것 보다 더 깨끗하게 설거지를 해 준다는게 신기하고 이제야 만날수 있게 된 식세기를 보면 자꾸 웃음이 나네요.플라스틱 반찬그릇이나 텀블러 등등 열에 의해서 깨끗해 진다고 생각하니까 너무 행복합니다.큰그릇을 넣을때는 상단 바스켓을 빼고도 가능합니다.상단 세척날개, 중단 세척날개, 하단 듀얼세철날개가 있어서 정말 깨끗하게 씻어질것 같습니다.그릇이 뽀송뽀송 변신해서 나오는것 같습니다.좀 적응이 안되는것은 생각보다 시간이 많이 걸린다는게...곧 적응해서 좀 더 편하게 사는 걸로 결정했습니다.너무 신세계를 만난것 같습니다.자동문열림 기능이 있어서 습기, 냄새도 걱정 없고 고온 습한 공기를 밖으로 빠르게 배출해 주는 점도 좋습니다.싱크대 자리가 부족하거나 3인가족 정도 사용하기에 딱 좋은것 같습니다. 아직 식세기 사용해 보지 않은 분들께 가성비로도 좋은 미디어 자동문열림 식기세척기 6인용을 추천합니다. 쿠팡체험단 이벤트로 상품을 무료로 제공 받아 작성한 구매 후기입니다.

Sentence (English): Are you looking at dishwashers?
Comments (English): [ It is a cost-effective dishwasher that is slim and neat. ] || ---------------- || Are you looking at dishwashers? Please consider the installation space, height, width, and workflow before purchasing. My house is small, so installing a 12-place setting dishwasher is difficult. We would have had to cut a section of the sink cabinet and do reinforcement work... it felt like paying double the cost. So, I chose a countertop model. Installation. Wow~ it's really fast. True Rocket Installation! They called me the very next day after I ordered, and I received the installation in the afternoon. They said it would take 30 minutes to an hour depending on the working environment, but since the hole for the water purifier was large, we used that hole as well. Although we didn't need to drill a hole, the water pressure was too weak, so they added a valve to the water connection. They explained everything well and kept to the schedule. They take away all the trash after installation. Product. Since the size is for 6 people, I thought it might be small, but as a 3-person household that doesn't use large pots often, it is sufficient for our house. It doesn't take up much space, and I love that it's slim. I chose ivory—the color is clean and matches my home well. It's also very simple to operate. Pros. - You can add dishes while the machine is running, a feature not found in LG models. - It has an automatic door opening function. - The price is reasonable. - The detergent dispenser is clean with no gaps or sharp edges, so there is no need to wash it separately due to sticking or jamming. - It has a separate cutlery holder. User Review: I assumed there would be an extra packet of dishwasher detergent included, so I didn't buy any in advance. But there wasn't any. So I hurriedly ordered a cheap, small-sized one via Rocket Delivery and tried running it in the dishwasher, and I am really satisfied. It is so convenient. Ha. I’m tearing up. Because it’s so good. Dishwashers are love~. When another detergent arrives, I’ll run a cycle with that and post a review~. ________________________________________. Comments (English): [ It's a whole new world. ] || ---------------- || Lately, I've heard a lot of good things about the Dishwasher Imoim. As a family of four who doesn't eat much at home, I didn't really need a dishwasher since there isn't much to wash. But after using it, it's a whole new world. I just removed the food scraps and ran it; I didn't have to worry about anything, so I just left it there and did other things, and it was done before I knew it. I was touched by how kind the installation technician was. I was worried the cutout hole might be too big, but they drilled it less than 1 centimeter, so it doesn't look bad, which makes me even more satisfied. It takes more time than washing dishes by hand, but I can do other things during that time. Plus, it sterilizes thoroughly, so it's cleaner than washing by hand. It isn't too big either, so I don't feel uncomfortable about it even though it isn't a built-in unit. I also like that the door opens automatically after washing to let the moisture escape. Although it is a compact size, it has a two-tier basket and a separate cutlery holder, so it seems spacious enough for a family of four. Since it has a window-style door, I can watch it running, and it is easy to use. So far, I am extremely satisfied. The Dishwasher Imoim offers great value for money. I recommend it to anyone who is considering buying one. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I've had this dishwasher for 2 months.
Comments (English): [ Good Dishwasher - quiet ] || ---------------- || I've had this dishwasher for 2 months. So far have been very happy with the cleaning ability. It does an excellent job getting my dishes clean without the need to preclean. It runs very quietly, surprisingly so. I really like the 3rd rack for putting long utensils and flat items. The regular utensil rack seems to work very well, especially appreciate the dedicated jets just for it.I've only used the bottle jet portion twice but it worked as advertised. I've put in some extremely dirty pans and dishes and they all came out very clean. I have had zero issues with dried on or filmy dishes. The only cons found are - feel for the cost the racks could be smoother in how they slide. The dishes do get dry but you definitely have to use the longer dry option if you want completely dry (to qualify, I do appreciate the way it dries you don't have to worry about melting plastic pieces like older or cheaper dishwashers). My final complaint would be how extremely sensitive the control panel is. We are constantly accidently lighting it up just barely touching near it as clean or do normal kitchen stuff. GE could definitely make improvements there (personally I prefer hard press buttons to the touch pads as never had this problem with my old dishwasher). In summary, a very competent dishwasher from a relatively trusted brand with premium features for a decent price, worth the little extra for some of the features.

Sentence (English): I bought this dishwasher (in May 2023) because I had read that GE dishwashers have a sort of built-in garbage disposal, plus this one had a good sound rating and the stainless finish is very nice.
Comments (English): [ Failure after just over a year ] || ---------------- || I bought this dishwasher (in May 2023) because I had read that GE dishwashers have a sort of built-in garbage disposal, plus this one had a good sound rating and the stainless finish is very nice. The dishwasher did an admirable job for a little over a year. Then suddenly it started throwing H2O errors (and the occasional Ftd error). Resetting it at the breaker worked to resolve these errors for a few months, but eventually it stopped helping. I dutifully checked the pressure sensor as all the online guidance suggests: cleaned it, reinstalled it, still problems; replaced it, still problems. Checked the inlet valve: fully functional. Good water pressure out of the wall. Cleaned the inlet hose; it was already clear. Replaced the turbidity sensor. Still not working. So now, almost exactly 18 months after purchasing this unit, I am replacing it. Another $300 on a service call to do exactly what I already did is not worth it. What a waste of half a grand. Very convenient how it started to fail just after the warranty expired.

Sentence (English): We replaced our GE dishwasher with this LG unit.
Comments (English): [ Mounting bracket issue ] || ---------------- || We replaced our GE dishwasher with this LG unit. I read reviews before I purchased and saw that many people said installation was easy so we decided to do it ourselves. Everything went smoothly until we got to the part where it should be mounted to the under the counter bracket. The stabilization tabs are on the far edges of this dishwasher but the mounting bracket holes do not go that far to the edge. One would think that a dishwasher mounting bracket would be universal but apparently not and I could not find a bracket specifically for LG products. So frustrating! Adding side mounting brackets were not an option so we drilled holes into the existing bracket after bending the tabs upward. Everything went smoothly until we got to the part where it should be mounted to the under the counter bracket. The stabilization tabs are on the far edges of this dishwasher but the mounting bracket holes do not go that far to the edge.  One would think that  a dishwasher mounting bracket would be universal but apparently not and I could not find a bracket specifically for LG products.  So frustrating!  Adding side mounting brackets were not an option so we drilled holes into the existing bracket after bending the tabs upward.  We got it done and I will have to cover up the screws that now show, but I think this should have been much easier.  How would I know that the mounting brackets wouldn’t match up? And if this was a new install, I wouldn’t have been able to find a bracket that fits anyway! And in my opinion, this is not a quiet dishwasher but it looks good and cleans well.  We plan to add some extra padding to see if that helps, otherwise it is what it is.

I was disappointed by all these minor issues but hoping that it will last and prove to be worth the extra expense.

Comments (English): [ Wonderful dishwasher ] || ---------------- || We bought our Bosch after our previous dishwasher started to leak. again. Comments (English): [ Just okay ] || ---------------- || I wanted a Bosch but the salesman said it would take months to get. I'm not sure I shouldn't have waited. It's okay and usually gets the dishes clean. The third rack on the top is deceptive. Only the half on the left has sprayers. The right side does not have any and seems to rely on water coming up from the bottom of the second rack. I generally need to wash my dishes before loading them in the third d rack or they often don't come clean. Either it isn't installed properly or it is supposed to stick out from the counter by several inches. Things spill on the control often because it sticks out so much. It goes through jet dry really quickly but without it everything comes out wet. It's quieter than the old machines from the 80's but not super quiet. You can definitely hear it in the next room while watching tv so it's best to run it over night. It takes three hours to do a load so it's difficult to do multiple loads in a day. All said it's okay but not worth worth the price tag.

Sentence (English): My husband doesn't trust dishwashers, and I can't stand to let dishes pile up, so I didn't use the built-in dishwasher we moved into.
Comments (English): My husband doesn't trust dishwashers, and I can't stand to let dishes pile up, so I didn't use the built-in dishwasher we moved into. Then my friends told me that it was so convenient to have a dishwasher, so I used the one at home twice, but it was loud and I felt uncomfortable, so I didn't use it after that. Then, after working together, I was stressed out about washing dishes after eating and cleaning up or when guests came over. Then I found out about the dishwasher! They said that a bigger size would be better, so I removed the 14-inch built-in dishwasher that was at home and installed it. I put spoons and cutlery in the upper compartment and dishes, bulky items, and tall items in the lower compartment. It washes well and is really convenient! I remove slightly large pieces of food and put an all-in-one detergent in the detergent container and run it. It's quieter and washes cleanly, so I'm satisfied :) It's definitely quieter than the previous one!
Comments (Original): 식세기를 못믿는 남편에 저는 설거지 거리를 쌓아두지 못하는 성격이라 이사 온집에 빌트인 식세기가 있어도 사용을 안했었어요 그러다 친구들이 식세기 이모님이 있으니 너무 편하다고 해서 집에 있는걸 두번 정도 사용했는데 소리도 큰 것 같고 괜히 찝찝한것같아 그 후로는 사용을 안했었어요  그러다 이번에 같이 일을하고 퇴근 후 밥먹고 치우거나 손님이 오는 날엔 설거지도 스트레스더라구요 그러다 알아본 식세기!! 사이즈는 큰게 좋다고 해서 14인치로 집에 있던 빌트인 식세기를 빼고 설치했어요 위에 칸 에는 수저나 식기도구를 놓고 밑에는 그릇이나 부피큰거나 높은 걸 놓고 사용하고 있어요 세척 잘 되고 정말 편하네요!!!! 살짝 큰 음식물 제거하고 올인원 세제하나 세제통에 넣고 돌리면 소음도 적고 깨끗하게 세척되어 만족해요:) 전에꺼랑 다르게 확실히 소음이 적네요!!

Sentence (English): If you've been agonizing over whether or not to buy a dishwasher for hundreds of thousands of times, try this simple guide.
Comments (English): [ If you've been thinking about the dishwasher hundreds of thousands of times, try this. ] || ---------------- || If you've been agonizing over whether or not to buy a dishwasher for hundreds of thousands of times, try this simple guide. I was like that. The kitchen is small, so I'll just diligently wash the dishes. Then, out of nowhere, the thought occurred to me, "But we're a family of six, wouldn't it be helpful to buy even a small one?" I've been pondering this for about a year. After having four kids, there are times when standing for long periods of time to wash dishes is difficult, and my husband helps, but when both of us are struggling, waking up to a pile of dishes is incredibly stressful. So, whenever I told my husband, "Let's buy it, let's buy it," he didn't seem to like the idea of me adding more appliances. He didn't give me a straight answer, so I hesitated to buy. But, as if an egg could penetrate a rock, one day a friend of mine said she was using a small dishwasher and it was fine. I asked her what she was using, and she said she used a Media one. That day, I suggested to my husband that we buy one. He listened to me, measured the length, and then decided to buy it. I told him I could sell it if it didn't work out, but in the end, I don't think I'll ever sell it. I'm so, so satisfied! I tried installing it directly next to the sink, but it took up too much space, so I put it back against the wall. It's not too far from the sink, so it's not too inconvenient to load dishes, and the installer said it's easier to load dishes if it opens to the side rather than the front. The white color is very clean, and the operation is simple, which I like. The automatic door opens naturally, which is nice, but it doesn't dry completely, so there might be some moisture. After eating, I just rinse the dishes and put them away, and that's it. It's a huge reduction in the amount of dishwashing labor. It's so wonderful to be able to wake up with a clean morning. It's truly a whole new world. They say the dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are three things that make a world of difference, and they really are. Now, I only have the robot vacuum. I don't think I need to buy that one, but this is the first time I've written such a long Coupang review. I hope everyone buys a dishwasher and enjoys it.

So, whenever I told my husband, "Let's buy it, let's buy it," he didn't seem to like the idea of me adding more appliances. He didn't give me a straight answer, so I hesitated to buy. But, as if an egg could penetrate a rock, one day a friend of mine said she was using a small dishwasher and it was fine. I asked her what she was using, and she said she used a Media one. That day, I suggested to my husband that we buy one. He listened to me, measured the length, and then decided to buy it. I told him I could sell it if it didn't work out, but in the end, I don't think I'll ever sell it. I'm so, so satisfied! I tried installing it directly next to the sink, but it took up too much space, so I put it back against the wall. It's not too far from the sink, so it's not too inconvenient to load dishes, and the installer said it's easier to load dishes if it opens to the side rather than the front. The white color is very clean, and the operation is simple, which I like. The automatic door opens naturally, which is nice, but it doesn't dry completely, so there might be some moisture. After eating, I just rinse the dishes and put them away, and that's it. It's a huge reduction in the amount of dishwashing labor. It's so wonderful to be able to wake up with a clean morning. It's truly a whole new world. They say the dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are three things that make a world of difference, and they really are. Now, I only have the robot vacuum. I don't think I need to buy that one, but this is the first time I've written such a long Coupang review. I hope everyone buys a dishwasher and enjoys it.

Then, out of nowhere, the thought occurred to me, "But we're a family of six, wouldn't it be helpful to buy even a small one?" I've been pondering this for about a year. After having four kids, there are times when standing for long periods of time to wash dishes is difficult, and my husband helps, but when both of us are struggling, waking up to a pile of dishes is incredibly stressful. So, whenever I told my husband, "Let's buy it, let's buy it," he didn't seem to like the idea of me adding more appliances. He didn't give me a straight answer, so I hesitated to buy. But, as if an egg could penetrate a rock, one day a friend of mine said she was using a small dishwasher and it was fine. I asked her what she was using, and she said she used a Media one. That day, I suggested to my husband that we buy one. He listened to me, measured the length, and then decided to buy it. I told him I could sell it if it didn't work out, but in the end, I don't think I'll ever sell it. I'm so, so satisfied! I tried installing it directly next to the sink, but it took up too much space, so I put it back against the wall. It's not too far from the sink, so it's not too inconvenient to load dishes, and the installer said it's easier to load dishes if it opens to the side rather than the front. The white color is very clean, and the operation is simple, which I like. The automatic door opens naturally, which is nice, but it doesn't dry completely, so there might be some moisture. After eating, I just rinse the dishes and put them away, and that's it. It's a huge reduction in the amount of dishwashing labor. It's so wonderful to be able to wake up with a clean morning. It's truly a whole new world. They say the dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are three things that make a world of difference, and they really are. Now, I only have the robot vacuum. I don't think I need to buy that one, but this is the first time I've written such a long Coupang review. I hope everyone buys a dishwasher and enjoys it.

Then, out of nowhere, the thought occurred to me, "But we're a family of six, wouldn't it be helpful to buy even a small one?" I've been pondering this for about a year. After having four kids, there are times when standing for long periods of time to wash dishes is difficult, and my husband helps, but when both of us are struggling, waking up to a pile of dishes is incredibly stressful. So, whenever I told my husband, "Let's buy it, let's buy it," he didn't seem to like the idea of me adding more appliances. He didn't give me a straight answer, so I hesitated to buy. But, as if an egg could penetrate a rock, one day a friend of mine said she was using a small dishwasher and it was fine. I asked her what she was using, and she said she used a Media one. That day, I suggested to my husband that we buy one. He listened to me, measured the length, and then decided to buy it. I told him I could sell it if it didn't work out, but in the end, I don't think I'll ever sell it. I'm so, so satisfied! I tried installing it directly next to the sink, but it took up too much space, so I put it back against the wall. It's not too far from the sink, so it's not too inconvenient to load dishes, and the installer said it's easier to load dishes if it opens to the side rather than the front. The white color is very clean, and the operation is simple, which I like. The automatic door opens naturally, which is nice, but it doesn't dry completely, so there might be some moisture. After eating, I just rinse the dishes and put them away, and that's it. It's a huge reduction in the amount of dishwashing labor. It's so wonderful to be able to wake up with a clean morning. It's truly a whole new world. They say the dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are three things that make a world of difference, and they really are. Now, I only have the robot vacuum. I don't think I need to buy that one, but this is the first time I've written such a long Coupang review. I hope everyone buys a dishwasher and enjoys it.

Sentence (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^ If you found my review helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free as part of the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity!
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well.
