Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^ If you found my review helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well.
