Comments (English): Purchased Product: Media 6-Person Dishwasher with Automatic Door Opening. Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase. I purchased a dishwasher through Coupang's great opportunity! I needed a dishwasher just in time, so thank you for giving me the opportunity to try it out. Description: 1. 3-stage washing blades -> Powerful cleaning across the upper, middle, and lower sections. 2. Slim size -> Easy to install even in tight spaces. 3. 2-stage basket -> Ample storage space. The Media 6-person dishwasher features a small 10mm perforation size to minimize the perforation area, reducing installation burden. If perforation is not required, a no-perforation installation is also possible. The powerful cleaning system, consisting of three upper, middle, and lower blades, maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring complete coverage without any blind spots. After washing, the door automatically opens to quickly exhaust hot, humid air. At the same time, the outside air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Once the door opens, wait 15 minutes for the appliance to cool completely before removing dishes. Do not approach the appliance when the door is open, as hot air may escape, risking burns. The spacious two-tier basket can accommodate everything from small dishes to large frying pans. The door opens to a 15cm space, allowing installation even in narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch control allow for easy and safe operation. The Media dishwasher offers four wash cycles (dry, low 60°C, high 75°C, normal 75°C) for a variety of settings. The Media dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility assessment and KC safety certification. <<Operating Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, wait 5 seconds, and open the door after the appliance has completely stopped operating. Add dishes, close the door, and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install! The product description said that perforation might not be necessary, so I thought they'd connect it to the back of the water purifier, which is already there. They said it was necessary, so I did. It's only about 10mm, so it wasn't too noticeable! And it's actually quite large. I installed it next to the water purifier, and it was completely full when the dishwasher was in there. Since it's a six-person dishwasher, I thought it would be fairly large, but it actually took up a lot of space. Still, it's nice that it can hold a lot of dishes, considering it's for six people. Before I had a dishwasher, I would just wring out the dishes and wash them by hand, without sterilizing them. That worried me about viruses, but now that the dishwasher washes and sterilizes them, I feel reassured! However, one cycle takes about 49-60 minutes. I checked other products and found similar times. They also told me I had to order a dishwasher detergent myself. I thought I could just use the dishwasher, but they say they have a special detergent for that purpose. I bought the detergent later and ran it for sterilization purposes. The lid opens automatically as it rinses with water and dries at high temperature. It was nice because it dried completely without any moisture after running it. Although it took up some space, the functionality was so great that I think the advantages outweighed them! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Sentence (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place capacity).
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. Sentence (English): Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang!
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.
