Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically.
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Sentence (English): Although it takes up space, the function is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages!
Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. This is a purchase review written after receiving the product for free through the Coupang Experience Group event.

Comments (English): Purchased Product: Midea Automatic Door Opening Dishwasher (6-Place Capacity). Purchase Date: 2024.11.19. Delivery Date: 2024.11.20. Reason for Purchase: I was able to purchase a dishwasher through a great opportunity on Coupang! I happened to need a dishwasher, so thank you for giving me the chance to try it out. Description: 1. 3-Stage Washing Blades -> Powerful cleaning across the top, middle, and bottom. 2. Slim Size -> Can be installed even in narrow spaces. 3. 2-Stage Basket -> Ample storage space. The Midea 6-Place Dishwasher reduces the burden of installation by minimizing the drilling area with a small 10mm hole size. If drilling is not required, drill-free installation is also available at the customer's discretion. The powerful washing system, consisting of a total of three washing blades (top, middle, and bottom), maximizes cleaning power and coverage, ensuring a clean wash without any blind spots. Once the wash is complete, the door opens automatically to rapidly expel hot, humid air, while external air naturally dries the dishes, effectively removing odors and moisture. Please remove the dishes 15 minutes after the door opens, once the interior has cooled sufficiently. Do not approach the unit when the door is open, as the expulsion of hot air poses a risk of burns. The generously sized two-tier basket allows for the storage of everything from small tableware to large frying pans. With 15cm of clearance when the door is open, it can be installed even on narrow sinks. The intuitive and convenient LED display and touch controls allow for easy and safe operation. The Midea dishwasher offers four wash cycles (Dry, Low Temperature 60°C, Intensive 75°C, and Standard 75°C), allowing you to choose the appropriate option for your needs. The Midea dishwasher has passed both EMC electromagnetic compatibility testing and KC safety certification. <<Operation Instructions>> Press the [Start/Stop] button, and open the door after 5 seconds when the operation has completely stopped. After adding dishes, close the door and press the [Start/Stop] button to resume operation. Overall Review: The installation technician contacted me separately and came to install it! The product description mentioned that drilling might not be mandatory, so I assumed they would connect it through the hole already drilled behind our water purifier. However, they confirmed that drilling was necessary, so I had one done. Since it was a small hole, about 10mm, it wasn't very noticeable! Also, seeing it in person, it was huge. We installed it next to our water purifier, and it completely filled the space once the dishwasher was placed inside. I expected it to be somewhat large since it is a 6-place setting dishwasher, and it did indeed take up a lot of space. Still, I liked that it fits a lot of dishes since it is a 6-place setting. Before I had a dishwasher, I used to just squeeze out dish soap and wash dishes by hand without sanitizing, so I was worried about various viruses. But now that the dishwasher handles both washing and sanitizing, I feel relieved! However, it takes about 49 to 60 minutes to run once. I looked up other products, and the time required seems similar. Also, you mentioned that I have to order the dishwasher-specific detergent separately. I thought I could just use regular dish soap, but apparently, there is a dedicated detergent. I decided to save the detergent for later and ran it for sanitizing purposes; it rinses with water and dries at high temperature, and the lid opens automatically. I liked that it dries everything thoroughly without any moisture after the cycle. Although it takes up space, the functionality is so excellent that I think the advantages outweigh the disadvantages! I will continue to use the dishwasher well. Thank you ^-^. If my review was helpful, I would appreciate it if you clicked 'Helpful'. Comments (English): [ If you've agonized over a dishwasher hundreds of thousands of times, try this. ] || ---------------- || If you’ve agonized hundreds of thousands of times over whether or not to buy a dishwasher, just try this simple solution. That’s exactly what happened to me. My kitchen is small, so I’d just think, "I’ll just be diligent about washing dishes." But then, the thought would suddenly cross my mind: "We’re a family of six, wouldn’t buying even a small one be helpful?" I think I agonized over this for about a year. After having four children, there were times when standing for long periods to wash dishes was difficult. Even though my husband helped, there were times when both of us struggled, and waking up to a pile of dishes in the morning was incredibly stressful. So, whenever I kept telling my husband, "Let's buy it, let's buy it!", he didn't give me an immediate answer, perhaps because he didn't like the idea of me accumulating appliances one by one. That made me hesitant to buy it right away. However, just as an egg can eventually break a rock, one day an acquaintance told me she uses a small dishwasher and it’s fine. When I asked what she used, she said she uses a Midea one, so I asked my husband that same day if he thought about buying one. He listened to me, measured the dimensions, and finally agreed to buy it. We agreed to sell it secondhand if we decided it wasn't right for us, but in the end, I don't think we’ll ever need to sell it. I am so, so satisfied! I tried installing it facing forward right next to the sink, but it killed off the cooking space, so I put it back against the wall. It isn't that far from the sink, so it isn't inconvenient when putting dishes in, and the technician even said that opening it sideways is easier than opening it forward. The white color is so clean, and I like that it operates simply. However, while the automatic door opening for natural drying is great, it doesn't dry completely, so there might be a little moisture left. The fact that I can just roughly rinse the dishes after a meal and neatly shove them in makes the chore of washing dishes drastically reduced. I am so incredibly happy to be able to greet the morning with a clean dish. It really feels like a whole new world. They say a dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are the three things that create a whole new world, and it really is true. Now I have the robot vacuum left to buy, though I don't think I really need it. This is the first time in my life I've written such a long review for Coupang. I hope everyone is happy after buying a dishwasher!

Even though my husband helped, there were times when both of us struggled, and waking up to a pile of dishes in the morning was incredibly stressful. He listened to me, measured the dimensions, and finally agreed to buy it. We agreed to sell it secondhand if we decided it wasn't right for us, but in the end, I don't think we’ll ever need to sell it. I am so, so satisfied! I tried installing it facing forward right next to the sink, but it killed off the cooking space, so I put it back against the wall. It isn't that far from the sink, so it isn't inconvenient when putting dishes in, and the technician even said that opening it sideways is easier than opening it forward. The white color is so clean, and I like that it operates simply. However, while the automatic door opening for natural drying is great, it doesn't dry completely, so there might be a little moisture left. The fact that I can just roughly rinse the dishes after a meal and neatly shove them in makes the chore of washing dishes drastically reduced. I am so incredibly happy to be able to greet the morning with a clean dish. It really feels like a whole new world. They say a dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are the three things that create a whole new world, and it really is true. Now I have the robot vacuum left to buy, though I don't think I really need it. This is the first time in my life I've written such a long review for Coupang. I hope everyone is happy after buying a dishwasher!

It isn't that far from the sink, so it isn't inconvenient when putting dishes in, and the technician even said that opening it sideways is easier than opening it forward. The white color is so clean, and I like that it operates simply. The fact that I can just roughly rinse the dishes after a meal and neatly shove them in makes the chore of washing dishes drastically reduced. I am so incredibly happy to be able to greet the morning with a clean dish. It really feels like a whole new world. They say a dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are the three things that create a whole new world, and it really is true. Now I have the robot vacuum left to buy, though I don't think I really need it. This is the first time in my life I've written such a long review for Coupang. Even though my husband helped, there were times when both of us struggled, and waking up to a pile of dishes in the morning was incredibly stressful. He listened to me, measured the dimensions, and finally agreed to buy it. We agreed to sell it secondhand if we decided it wasn't right for us, but in the end, I don't think we’ll ever need to sell it. I am so, so satisfied! I tried installing it facing forward right next to the sink, but it killed off the cooking space, so I put it back against the wall. The white color is so clean, and I like that it operates simply. The fact that I can just roughly rinse the dishes after a meal and neatly shove them in makes the chore of washing dishes drastically reduced. I am so incredibly happy to be able to greet the morning with a clean dish. It really feels like a whole new world. They say a dryer, dishwasher, and robot vacuum are the three things that create a whole new world, and it really is true. Now I have the robot vacuum left to buy, though I don't think I really need it. This is the first time in my life I've written such a long review for Coupang. Sentence (English): This dishwasher is extremely efficient: the dishes are always spotless, whether in a short or long cycle.
Comments (English): [ A practical, connected and efficient dishwasher ] || ---------------- || This dishwasher is extremely efficient: the dishes are always spotless, whether in a short or long cycle. Although compact, the fittings are partially modular, which gives it a very respectable capacity. Finally, the connected function is practical for downloading new programs or consulting its usage statistics. Only two points could be improved: 1) a "3 in 1" button to indicate that you are using all-in-one tablets would be simpler than having to manually modify the regenerating salt and rinse aid settings. 2) in the auto cycle, the solid tablets are not always completely used, which leaves traces of detergent on the dishes. Additional sensors could ensure that the tablet is completely used before starting the rinse.
Comments (Original): [ Un lave-vaisselle pratique, connecté et efficace ] || ---------------- || Ce lave-vaisselle est extrêmement efficace : la vaisselle est systématiquement impeccable, que ce soit en cycle court ou en cycle long. Bien que compact, les aménagements sont partiellement modulables, ce qui lui confère une capacité très honorable. Enfin, la fonction connectée est pratique pour télécharger de nouveaux programmes ou consulter ses statistiques d'utilisation.Seuls deux points pourraient être améliorés : 1) une touche '3 en 1' pour signaler que l'on utilise des pastilles tout en un serait plus simple que de devoir modifier manuellement les paramètres de sel régénérant et de liquide de rinçage.2) en cycle auto, les pastilles solides ne sont pas toujours totalement utilisées, ce qui laisse des traces de détergent sur la vaisselle. Des capteurs supplémentaires pourraient s'assurer que la pastille est totalement consommée avant d'amorcer le rinçage.

Sentence (English): I'm going to try to recount in an orderly manner everything that has been involved in changing the dishwasher, the installation being very quick and without any problems.
Comments (English): [ SILENCE MADE DISHWASHER ] || ---------------- || I'm going to try to recount in an orderly manner everything that has been involved in changing the dishwasher, the installation being very quick and without any problems. The first thing I did, and which I recommend to everyone, was to read the operating instructions. It may seem silly but it will save you a lot of scares. In this case, what they recommend is to fill the salt tank (with approximately 1 kg and water) as well as the rinse aid tank. Be careful with this, because at least I haven't used it since I put the all-in-one tablets in the previous one, but if you don't put rinse aid in, an error light will stay on. Once properly prepared, I proceeded to fill it, at full load, to start testing it. The first time I set it to automatically select the program, since you have several options to choose from, eco, half load, auto, and it even comes with a test strip to measure the water hardness and to be able to manually select the washing conditions, following the instructions in the instruction manual. As I said, I set the dishwasher to select the most suitable programme based on the load and the type of water. At first I was a little confused because it made a slight noise but I didn't feel like it was loading water. After a while it started, so I deduced that what it was doing was calibrating what was most suitable. During the entire wash cycle the display shows you the time left and if I have to highlight something it is its absolute silence.
